en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large, early‑20th‑century institutional building, likely a school or hospital, with a long tiled roof, many evenly spaced windows, and modest dormers. A tree‑filled garden separates the building from a street in the foreground, which is bordered by a plastered wall and metal gate. A tram or trolley line with overhead wires runs along the street. A handwritten or stamped number "27087" appears at the top right of the image, suggesting an archival or publisher's catalog number.
